module: Computes a vehicle's performance index (PI) and class (X, S, A, B, C, D) from its automatic test results (0-60 time, 1/8 and 1/4 mile, trap speeds, braking in g, etc.). Also provides aggregate scores compared to a reference vehicle, class utilities for the UI (minimum class requirement) and selection of a mission's default vehicle. The data comes from vehicle configs ("Performance Data", "Drag Times", "Power", "Weight").
usage:
local res = gameplay_vehiclePerformance.getClassFromConfig("sunburst2", "base")
if res then print(res.class.name, res.performanceIndex) end
notes: Classes (minimum PI): X 101, S 86, A 66, B 41, C 21, D 0.
The PI is the sum of nine terms bias + multiplier * measurement, each floored at 0; a missing measurement counts as 0.
getClassFromData never returns nil because of the PI (always a number); it returns nil only if testData is nil (error) or if the PI is below the lowest threshold, which cannot happen with D at 0.
getClassFromConfigTable modifies the received 'Drag Times' table: it adds power and weight to it.

getAggregateScores divides by testData.time_60, time_1_4, velAt_1_4/velAt_1_8 without checking: missing or zero values cause an error or a division by zero. If time_0_60 is 0 (60 mph not reached), it is reset to nil in testData and the score is 0.
Certification vehicle references: power 1 395 241 W, weight 1280 kg, 0-60 mph 2.37 s, braking 1.417 g (values from the code).

getAggregateScores.desc: Computes aggregate scores (power, power-to-weight ratio, 0-60 mph, 60 ft, quarter mile, speed progression, braking) as a percentage of the reference vehicle.

testData.desc: Test data: time_60, time_1_4, time_0_60, velAt_1_8, velAt_1_4, brakingG, power ({propulsionPowerCombined}), weight.

returns.desc: {powerScore, powerToWeightScore, timeTo60Score, quarterMileScore, speedProgressionScore, brakingGForceScore, time0To60Score}

getClassFromData.desc: Computes the PI from the test data and returns the first class whose minimum PI is reached.

testData.desc: Test data (time_60, time_330, time_1000, time_1_8, time_1_4, time_0_60, velAt_1_8, velAt_1_4, brakingG).

getClassFromConfigTable.desc: Reads the class and PI already recorded by the automatic test (config["Performance Data"]); otherwise recomputes them from config["Drag Times"], config["Power"] and config["Weight"].

returns.desc: {class, performanceIndex} or nil if no data.

getClassFromVehId.desc: Class of a vehicle present in the game, via core_vehicles.getVehicleDetails(vehId).configs.

getClassFromConfig.desc: Class of a vehicle config identified by model and config name (core_vehicles.getConfig).

getClassByName.desc: Returns the class row matching the given letter.

name.desc: Class letter (X, S, A, B, C, D).

getClassNames.desc: Lists the class names, from highest to lowest.

buildClassRequirement.desc: Builds a table in the performance index badge format for a class requirement alone; isThreshold = true tells the UI to display a minimum threshold (>=).

returns.desc: {class = {name, description, minPI}, performanceIndex = minPI, isThreshold = true} or nil if the class is unknown.

getDefaultMissionVehicleSpec.desc: Determines the default vehicle implied by a mission's setupModules.vehicles block (the one the settings UI preselects): the player's vehicle, the first preset, or nothing.

setupModule.desc: Setup module: enabled, includePlayerVehicle, prioritizePlayerVehicle, vehicles ({model, config}).
